chunks: He was asked about a man who says, "Upon me are a thousand camels," while he is in ihram for a thousand hajj. He said: "Those are the footsteps of Satan."
And about a man who says, while in ihram for hajj, or says, "I offer this food as a hady," he said: "It is nothing. Food is not offered as hady."

Or if he says of a camel after it has been slaughtered, "It is an offering to the House of Allah," then only camels are offered while they are alive, and they are not offered once they have become meat.

key_terms.بَدَنَةٍ: a sacrificial camel intended for offering
key_terms.خُطُوَاتُ ٱلشَّيْطَانِ: misleading promptings or paths attributed to Satan
key_terms.لِبَيْتِ ٱللَّهِ: for the House of Allah, meaning the Sacred House in Makkah
key_terms.مُحْرِمٌ: a person in the state of ihram for hajj or 'umrah
key_terms.هَدْيٌ: an offering sent or designated for the Sacred House
key_terms.ٱلطَّعَامَ: food, which here is ruled not to qualify as hady by such a statement
key_terms.ٱلْبُدْنُ: large sacrificial camels offered as hady

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith say about declaring offerings or hady during hajj?
ai.summary: This hadith gives legal rulings about invalid forms of vow-like or offering statements connected to hajj and hady. It rejects exaggerated utterances, clarifies that food is not designated as hady in this manner, and states that sacrificial animals are offered only while still alive, not after becoming meat.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.4295 - Imam (as) was asked about a man who says, "I am obligated to offer a thousand camels" while he is in the state of ihram for a thousand Hajj.
Imam (as) said: "These are the steps of Satan."
And regarding a man who, while in ihram for Hajj, says, "I will offer this food as a gift,"
Imam (as) said: "It is of no consequence. Food is not offered as a gift."
Or if he says about a camel after it has been slaughtered, "This is an offering to the House of Allah (swt),"
Imam (as) said: "Offerings are made while the animals are alive, and they are not offered after they have become meat."
